title: Additive Growth Without Rewrites (P0 → P6)
lead: Software should pay only for the complexity it needs today. Seamlessly evolve across 7 progressive stages within a single repository, driven by declarative configuration.
p0_desc: Marketing sites, landing pages, and technical books with zero runtime cost and instant edge hosting.
p1_desc: Hydrate interactive UI widgets with pure Go WebAssembly without Node.js or npm bloat.
p2_desc: Single Go binary combining HTTP routing, embedded templates, and lightweight database models.
p3_desc: Enforce clean domain boundaries across Workspace ⊃ Module ⊃ Domain ⊃ Service ⊃ Unit.
p4_desc: Decouple presentation from backend API services with typed schema contracts and gateway routing.
p5_desc: Extract asynchronous job queues, scheduled recurring tasks, and dedicated service containers.
p6_desc: Multi-tenant edge gateways, service discovery, resilient circuit breakers, and OpenTelemetry.
